narr: An isolated instance of flash flooding occurred due to heavy rainfall from a thunderstorm in Prince Georges County.
ev: Prince Georges County Fire and Rescue deployed boats to rescue people from high water around MD-201 Kenilworth Avenue and MD-450 Annapolis Road and MD-410 Riverdale Road. Several vehicles were stranded. Police closed the road.
